channel.title: The Nevada Independent - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Nevada Independent (thenevadaindependent.com)

item.title: Lawsuit: ICE detainee in Nevada loses eye in psychotic episode after being denied meds
item.description: A legal green card holder with schizophrenia alleges in a new lawsuit that he mutilated himself after being repeatedly denied his medications while in immigration custody at the Nevada Southern Detention Center.

item.title: In Las Vegas, where every drop of water counts, septic system changes are a sore subject
item.description: Septic tank conversions reveal a larger conservation issue; some say the government should look elsewhere to save water as experts say the region needs more.

item.title: Detenido de ICE en Nevada pierde un ojo en episodio psicótico tras negársele medicamentos
item.description: El titular de una tarjeta de residencia legal permanente quien padece esquizofrenia alega en demanda que se mutiló a sí mismo después de que en varias ocasiones se le negaron sus medicamentos mientras estaba bajo custodia migratoria en el Centro de Detención del Sur de Nevada.

item.title: Sportsbook operation a marriage of convenience for Caesars and Resort at Summerlin
item.description: The partnership between a Strip giant and a locals casino is a mutually beneficial business agreement. Also, an Illinois slot operator is growing in Nevada.

item.title: Washoe County schools leader to retire after 2 years on the job
item.description: During his time as superintendent, Ernst worked to improve issues such as chronic absenteeism while confronting challenges such a projected budget deficit in part due to declining enrollment.

item.title: Reos de Nevada y sus familiares dicen que programa de tabletas portátiles es más 'abusivo" que práctico
item.description: Defensores de los internos están haciendo un llamado para protestar por problemas en precios y calidad del programa de tabletas.

item.title: OPINION: What's so funny about peace, love and affordability?
item.description: No wonder the public was extremely skeptical about the president's signature omnibus spending package. While some positives were included in the bill, it was also packed with massive spending and unintended consequences.

item.title: Nevada likely to fall short of clean energy goals because of data centers
item.description: Six years after Nevada voters approved a constitutional amendment requiring in-state utilities to get half of their power from renewable sources by 2030, NV Energy says it is on track to miss those clean energy standards for the first time because of overwhelming demand from data centers.

item.title: Iran war spikes Nevada gas prices; Lombardo asks California to delay emission changes
item.description: Costs at the pump are up 14 percent, and the governor says Nevada is 'structurally dependent' on California providing necessary fuel for residents and visitors.

item.title: Washoe County superintendent says decision to resign 2 years early was purely personal
item.description: The Washoe County School District has struggled with superintendent turnover. In 2024, Joe Ernst became the district's fifth superintendent within 10 years.
